Definition: Arad, the name of a place near Palestine, also of a Canaanite and an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Arad = "a wild ass"; n pr m; 1) a Benjamite, son of Beriah, who drove out the inhabitants of Gath; n pr loc; 2) a royal city of the Canaanites north of the wilderness of Judah
